name: ChatGPT Conversions API
description: Send conversion events to the ChatGPT Conversions API.

pixel_id.label: Pixel ID
pixel_id.description: The Pixel ID from the Conversions tab in Ads Manager.

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.description: The Conversions API key from the Conversions tab in Ads Manager.

validate_only.label: Validate Only
validate_only.description: When enabled, ChatGPT Conversions API validates events without saving them. Use this for test scenarios only.

sendConversion.title: Send Conversion
sendConversion.description: Send a web, app or custom conversion event to the ChatGPT Conversions API.

event_type.label: Event Type
event_type.description: The ChatGPT Conversions API event type to send. Custom events also require a Custom Event Name.

custom_event_name.label: Custom Event Name
custom_event_name.description: The name of the custom event. Letters, digits, underscores and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit. It is lowercased, and must not match a standard event type.

event_id.label: Event ID
event_id.description: A unique ID for the event, used for deduplication. Reuse the Measurement Pixel event ID so browser and server events are deduplicated, and so retries are not counted twice.

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the event occurred. ChatGPT Conversions API rejects events more than 7 days old or more than 10 minutes in the future.

action_source.label: Action Source
action_source.description: Where the conversion happened. Defaults to Web when the event has a page URL, otherwise Other. App Installed and App Opened events must use Mobile App.

source_url.label: Source URL
source_url.description: The URL of the page where the event occurred, including scheme and host. Required for Web events.

oppref.label: OpenAI Click Reference
oppref.description: The oppref click ID from the landing page URL. It is sent unchanged. The ChatGPT Conversions API browser plugin captures it in the browser and adds it to every later event.

opt_out.label: Opt Out
opt_out.description: When true, opts the user out of future user-level personalization.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: The total value of the event. Provide it as a decimal number in the currency major unit, for example 100.05 for $100.05. Segment converts it to integer minor units (cents) before sending to ChatGPT Conversions API, so 100.05 USD is sent as 10005. Do not pre-convert it to minor units.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the amount, for example USD. Required when an amount is mapped.

plan_id.label: Plan ID
plan_id.description: The ID of the plan for subscription, trial and custom events.

contents.label: Contents
contents.description: The items involved in the event. Not available for appointment, lead, registration and app events. Item amounts are per unit. Any additional keys you add to an item, such as size or color, are sent to ChatGPT Conversions API as variant attributes, and their values are converted to strings. Do not use id, group_id, name, content_type, quantity, amount or currency as variant keys.

id.label: Item ID
id.description: Your internal ID for the item.

group_id.label: Group ID
group_id.description: The product group or category ID of the item.

name.label: Name
name.description: A human readable name for the item.

content_type.label: Content Type
content_type.description: A category for the item, for example product, plan or page.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: The number of units. Sent as an integer.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: The price of one unit. Provide it as a decimal number in the currency major unit, for example 19.99 for $19.99. Segment converts it to integer minor units (cents) before sending to ChatGPT Conversions API, so 19.99 USD is sent as 1999.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code of the item amount. Defaults to the event currency.

essential_identifiers.label: Essential Identifiers
essential_identifiers.description: At least one essential identifier is required.

email.label: Email
email.description: The user's email addresses, up to 3, for example jane@example.com. Segment trims each one, lowercases it and SHA-256 hashes it. A SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) is sent as is. Any values after the first 3 are ignored.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: The user's phone numbers with country code, up to 3, for example +14155550123 (8 to 15 digits). Segment removes spaces, brackets, dots, dashes and a leading + or zeros from each one, then SHA-256 hashes it. A SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) is sent as is. Any values after the first 3 are ignored.

android_advertising_id.label: Android Advertising ID
android_advertising_id.description: The user's Android Google Advertising ID (GAID) as a 36 character UUID, for example 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000. Sent unhashed. IDFA is not supported.

matching_data.label: Matching Data
matching_data.description: Optional identifiers and user details that help ChatGPT Conversions API match the event to a user. They work best when sent together.

obref.label: OpenAI Browser Reference
obref.description: The user's OpenAI browser reference (obref) value. Sent unhashed. The ChatGPT Conversions API browser plugin reads it from the __obref cookie, which requires the user's measurement consent. Falls back to the anonymous ID.

external_id.label: External ID
external_id.description: Your own ID for the user, for example a user ID. Segment trims it and SHA-256 hashes it. A SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) is sent as is.

user_agent.label: User Agent
user_agent.description: The user's browser user agent string. Sent unhashed.

ip_address.label: IP Address
ip_address.description: The user's IPv4 or IPv6 address, for example 203.0.113.7. Sent unhashed. An invalid address causes the event to be rejected.

first_name.label: First Name
first_name.description: The user's first name. Segment lowercases it, removes spaces and punctuation, and SHA-256 hashes it. A SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) is sent as is.

last_name.label: Last Name
last_name.description: The user's last name. Segment lowercases it, removes spaces and punctuation, and SHA-256 hashes it. A SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) is sent as is.

city.label: City
city.description: The user's city as plain text, for example San Francisco. Sent unhashed. Maximum 128 characters.

region.label: Region
region.description: The user's state or region as plain text, for example California or CA. Sent unhashed. Maximum 128 characters.

country.label: Country
country.description: The user's two letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example US. Sent unhashed. An unrecognized code causes the event to be rejected.

postal_code.label: Postal Code
postal_code.description: The user's postal or ZIP code as plain text, for example 94105. Sent unhashed. Maximum 32 characters.

enable_batching.label: Batch Data to ChatGPT Conversions API
enable_batching.description: When enabled, Segment sends events to ChatGPT Conversions API in batches.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: The maximum number of events to send in each batch.

presets.name: ChatGPT Conversions API Browser Plugin
presets.subscribe: type = "track" or type = "identify" or type = "group" or type = "page" or type = "alias"
